purpose: Lints the DECODED claims of a workload-identity token and, optionally, of a token produced by an exchange, against a policy you declare: a maximum lifetime in seconds, a maximum actor-chain depth, required audience values, an allowed trust-domain list, and whether the exchanged scope must narrow. Checks that the subject is a well-formed SPIFFE identifier in an allowed trust domain, that the audience is present and matches, that expiry is present and the lifetime stays within the declared maximum, that issued-at and not-before are sane against a clock you supply, that every actor in the actor chain is an identifier and the chain is not deeper than allowed, that a may-act claim is consistent with the first actor of the exchanged token, and that an exchanged scope is a subset of the subject scope and the exchanged audience or resource is not wider. The verdict is within policy, outside policy, or indeterminate when a claim the policy needs is absent; an absent claim is never guessed. Values only: names, e-mail addresses, free text, unknown claims, signature material and anything shaped like a compact signed token are refused with an explicit code and never echoed, as are claim values of the wrong type, negative numeric dates, and a may-act claim that is not one well-formed actor object. Lints claims you paste against a policy you declare. It does not verify signatures, does not contact an identity provider and does not prove the token is genuine.
